verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              काले गच्छति तौ सौम्यौ दारकौ कृतनामकौ। कृष्णसङ्कर्षणौ चोभौ रिङ्गिणौ समपद्यताम्॥१॥
तावन्योन्यगतौ बालौ बाल्यादेवैकतां गतौ। एकमूर्तिधरौ कान्तौ बालचन्द्रार्कवर्चसौ॥२॥
verses.english: And oh, king janamejaya, cAkshuSha manu sired ten sons, starting with one called ऊरु, through lady नड्वल... thus the sixth time cycle is recollected...
verses.bhavadeepa: अथास्मिन्सप्तमेऽध्याये यमलार्जुनयोर्भिदा। मध्यङ्गतेन कृष्णेन ध्वस्तावेवेति वर्ण्यते॥ काले रिङ्गिणौ जानुभ्यां रंहणशीलौ॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: एकनिर्माणनिर्मुक्तावेकशय्यासनाशनौ। एकवेषहरावेकं पुष्यमानौ शिशुव्रतम्॥३॥
verses.english: Oh, boy, these accounts of manvantarA-s will not come to an end even if narrate them for hundreds of years... so let me tell you in a nutshell about all the time cycles, fourteen in all..." vaishampAyana thus started to narrate.

verses.sanskrit: एककार्यान्तरगतावेकदेहौ द्विधाकृतौ। एकचर्यौ महावीर्यावेकस्य शिशुतां गतौ॥४॥
verses.english: Oh, boy, these accounts of manvantarA-s will not come to an end even if narrate them for hundreds of years... so let me tell you in a nutshell about all the time cycles, fourteen in all..." vaishampAyana thus started to narrate.

verses.sanskrit: एकप्रमाणौ लोकानां देववृत्तान्तमानुषौ। कृत्स्नस्य जगतो गोपा संवृत्तौ गोपदारकौ॥५॥
verses.english: So far six eras called manvantara-s have lapsed... they are स्वायम्भुव, स्वारोcइष, उत्तम, तामस, रैवत, cआक्शुष manvantara-s... bearing the titles after their presiding मनु-s... and the present one is called वैस्वस्वत manvantam...
verses.bhavadeepa: एकस्य कार्यस्य अन्तरं रहस्यं गतौ प्राप्तौ एककार्यनिष्ठावित्यर्थः॥४॥

verses.sanskrit: अन्योन्यव्यतिषक्ताभिः क्रीडाभिरभिशोभितौ। अन्योन्यकिरणग्रस्तौ चन्द्रसूर्याविवाम्बरे॥६॥
verses.english: In the forthcoming manvantara-s, three belong to सावर्णि, रैभ्य, भौत्य, and four to मेरु-सावर्णि-s, who are ब्रह्म- सावर्णि, रुद्र- सावर्णि, मेरु- सावर्णि, and दक्ष- सावर्णि. These four सावर्णि-s are recognised as मेरु- सावर्णि-s, because they became one with the Absolute on performing ascesis on Mt. Meru...
verses.bhavadeepa: देवानां वृत्तान्तः सिद्धान्तः पापिष्ठा हन्तव्या यज्ञदानादिकं च प्रवर्तनीयमित्येवंरूपस्तदर्थं मानुष्यभूतौ देववृत्तान्तमानुषौ॥५॥

verses.sanskrit: विसर्पन्तौ तु सर्वत्र सर्पभोगभुजावुभौ। रेजतुः पांसुदिग्धाङ्गौ दृप्तौ कलभकाविव॥७॥
verses.english: I have said about the past, present and future manu-s... now I will say something, rather as much as I know, about the progeny and presiding deities, and about the seven-sages of those 6 manvantara-s that are bygone...
verses.bhavadeepa: व्यतिषक्ताभिर्भिश्राभिः। ग्रस्तौ पूर्णमास्यां चन्द्रोदये सूर्यस्यास्तमयः तदुदये इन्दोरितिः तयोरन्योन्यकिरणग्रस्तत्वम्॥६॥

verses.sanskrit: क्वचिद्भस्मप्रदीप्ताङ्गौ करीषप्रोक्षितौ क्वचित्। तौ तत्र पर्यधावेतां कुमाराविव पावकी॥८॥
verses.english: These seven are reckoned as seven-sages by virtue of their basic traits, say शम, दम आदि गुणा-s, and these are long-lived, hymnologists, foresighted, and self-sovereign...
verses.bhavadeepa: सर्पभोगभुजौ सर्पदेहतुल्यबाहू। कलभसदृशौ कलभकाविव स्वार्थे वा कः॥७॥

verses.sanskrit: क्वचिज्जानुभिरुद्घृष्टैः सर्पमाणौ विरेजतुः। क्रीडन्तौ वत्सशालासु शकृद्दिग्धाङ्गमूर्धजौ॥९॥
verses.english: And if the people on getting up in the morning sing to the praise of these great sages of present and future will derive happiness, renown, and longevity...

verses.sanskrit: शुशुभाते श्रिया जुष्टावानन्दजननौ पितुः। जनं च विप्रकुर्वाणौ विहसन्तौ क्वचित्क्वचित्॥१०॥
verses.english: 2. स्वारोचिष मन्व्न्तरम्: During this era, vasiShTha's son और्व, along with स्तम्ब, कश्यप, प्राण, बृहस्पति, दत्त, निश्च्यवन are the seven-sages in Great Bear, while gods are designated as तुषिता-s, as has been said in वायु पुराण...

verses.sanskrit: तौ तत्र कौतूहलिनौ मूर्धजव्याकुलेक्षणौ। रेजतुश्चन्द्रवदनौ दारकौ सुकुमारकौ॥११॥
verses.english: These blemishless sages are stationed in brahma's abode and they are reverential by the way of their birth, ascesis, education and heuristic methods - मन्त्रम् व्याकरण...

verses.sanskrit: अतिप्रसक्तौ तौ दृष्ट्वा सर्वव्रजविचारिणौ। नाशकत्तौ वारयितुं नन्दगोपः सुदुर्मदौ॥१२॥
verses.english: They act collectively with their knowledge about the triad of times, and by the virtue of their ascesis...

verses.sanskrit: ततो यशोदा सङ्क्रुद्धा कृष्णं कमललोचनम्। आनाय्य शकटीमूले भर्त्सयन्ती पुनः पुनः॥१३॥
verses.english: ४। तामस मन्वन्तरम्: Now let me say something about fourth time cycle called tAmasa manvantaram... in this period the seven-sages are: काव्य, पृथु, अग्नि, जन्यु, धाता, कपीवान्, and अ-कपीवान्... and they had many sons, so say पुराणा-s... the devA hosts in this time-cycle, तामस मन्वन्तरम्, are called सत्या-s...

verses.sanskrit: दाम्ना चैवोदरे बद्ध्वा प्रत्यबन्धदुलूखले। यदि शक्तोऽसि गच्छेति तमुक्त्वा कर्म साकरोत्॥१४॥
verses.english: And I will tell about the ten mighty sons of tAmasa manu.. they are: द्युति, तपस्य, सु-तप, तपो-मूल, तपो-धन, तपो-रति, अकल्माष, तन्वि, धन्वि, and परन्-तप...

verses.sanskrit: व्यग्रायां तु यशोदायां निर्जगाम ततोऽङ्गणात्। शिशुलीलां ततः कुर्वन्कृष्णो विस्मापयन्व्रजम्॥१५॥
verses.english: ५। रैवत मन्वन्तरम्: Next, about the fifth cycle called रैवत manvantaram, which is also cited by vAyu-purANa... the seven sages in this fifth cycle are: वेद-बाहु, यदुध्र, अन्द् थे saint वेद-शिर, हिरण्य-रोमा, पर्जन्य, and the son of सोम is called ऊर्ध्व-बाहु, and the son of sage अत्रि इस् called सत्य-नेत्र...

verses.sanskrit: सोऽङ्गणान्निस्सृतः कृष्णः कर्षमाण उलूखलम्। यमलाभ्यां प्रवृद्धाभ्यामर्जुनाभ्यां चरन्वने। मध्यान्निश्चक्राम तयोः कर्षमाण उलूखलम्॥१६॥
verses.english: And the gods in this cycle are called as भूत-रजस, who are also called as अ-भूत-रजस; and पारिव्रज, पारि-प्लव...

verses.sanskrit: तत्तस्य कर्षतो बद्धं तिर्यग्गतमुलूखलम्। लग्नं ताभ्यां सुमूलाभ्यामर्जुनाभ्यां चकर्ष च॥१७॥
verses.english: Listen about the sons of this raivata manu as I say about them... धृति-मान्, अव्यय, युक्त, तत्त्व-दर्शि, निर्-उत्सुक, अरण्य, प्रकाश, निर्-मोह, सत्य-वाक्, and one more who is called कवि... these are the sons of fifth manu, namely raivta...

verses.sanskrit: तावर्जुनौ कृष्यमाणौ तेन बालेन रंहसा। समूलविटपौ भग्नौ स तु मध्ये जहास वै॥१८॥
verses.english: ६। cआक्शुष मन्वन्तरम्: Now listen about the sixth manvantaram called cआक्शुष मन्वन्तरम्॥। the seven-sages in this cycle are the great sages called भृगु, नभ, विवस्वान्, सुधामा, विरजा, अतिनामा, and सहिष्णु... and the gods dwelling in heaven are known as a group of five, called आद्या, प्रभूता, ऋभव, पृथक्-भाव, and लेखा... these highsouled and highly radiant beings are the descendants of sage अन्गीरस...
verses.bhavadeepa: तत्तस्येति। अर्जुनाभ्याम् अर्जुनौ उद्धर्तुमित्यर्थः। अत्रेदमाम्नायते- “यत्र मन्थां विबध्नते रश्मीन् यमितवा इव। उलूखलसुतानामवेन्द्विन्द्र जल्गुलः। ता नो अद्य वनस्पती ऋष्वावृष्वेभिः सोतृभिः। इन्द्राय मधुमत्सुतम्” इति। यत्र उलूखले मन्थां मन्थानमिव मन्थानं लोकक्लेशकरं मां विबध्नते विशेषेण बघ्नन्ति मातरः रश्मीनादाय रश्मिभिरित्यर्थः। यमितवा इव विनिग्रहीतुमिव न तु वस्तुतो निग्रहीतुं मातृत्वेन मयि स्निग्धत्वात् तेन उलूखलेन सुतानां पीडितानां कर्मणि षष्ठी उलूखलपीडितान् अस्मान् हे इन्द्र मोचनसमर्थ अव रक्ष। पादादित्वादाद्युदात्तमाख्यातम्। इन्दु एवमेव त्वं जल्गुलोऽसि एनं मुञ्चामीति जल्पितुं मां च गोपितुं त्रातुं लातुम् आदातुं स्वाधीनं कर्तुं च समर्थोऽसि यतः अतोऽव मामित्यर्थः। एवं यदा सर्वान् प्रार्थयन्नपि न मोचनं लभते तदा वनस्पत्योरन्तरा गत्वा बन्धनदाम त्रोटितुं यावद्बलं करोति तावद्वनस्पती एव उन्मूलितौ दृष्ट्वा वदति। ता नो इति। त्रातौ नोऽस्माकं व्रजवासिनां वनस्पतिभूतौ अतिप्रसिद्धौ यमलौ अर्जुनजातीयौ भो वनस्पती अद्य इन्द्राय इन्द्रं प्रति गन्तुं सुतं तदुन्मूलनेन आत्मानं पीडयन्तं तदेव मधुमत् अमृतयुक्तम् अतिसम्यगित्यर्थः। यतः ऋष्वो गतिमन्तौ युवां स्थावरत्वान्मुक्तौ स्थ इत्यर्थः। ऋष्वेभिर्गतिमद्भिर्जङ्गमैः जनैः सोतृभिरस्मद्बन्धनकरैरुपलक्षितौ॥१७॥

verses.sanskrit: निदर्शनार्थं गोपाणां दिव्यं स्वबलमास्थितः। तद्दाम तस्य बालस्य प्रभावादभवद्दृढम्॥१९॥
verses.english: And oh, king janamejaya, cAkshuSha manu sired ten sons, starting with one called ऊरु, through lady नड्वल... thus the sixth time cycle is recollected...

verses.sanskrit: यमुनातीरमार्गस्था गोप्यस्तं ददृशुः शिशुम्। क्रन्दन्त्यो विस्मयन्त्यश्च यशोदां ययुरङ्गनाः॥२०॥
verses.english: ७। वैस्वस्वत मन्वन्तम्: And now, during this era, the seventh time cycle, called वैस्वस्वत मन्वन्तम्, the seven-sages are: अत्रि, वशिष्ठ, कश्यप, गौतम, भरद्वाज, and विश्वामित्र... where the seventh one is the son of godly sage रिचीक, namely जमदग्नि...

verses.sanskrit: तास्तु सम्भ्रान्तवदना यशोदामूचुरङ्गनाः। एह्यागच्छ यशोदे त्वं सम्भ्रमात्किं विलम्बसे॥२१॥
verses.english: And the gods in this present time cycle, वैस्वस्वत मन्वन्तम्, are called are: साध्या-s, रुद्रा-s, विश्वे-देवा-s, वसु-s, मरुत्-s, and आदित्या-s... vaivasvata manu sired ten children starting from the highsouled इक्श्वाकु et al, and the progeny of ikshvAku flourished with sons and grandsons, who rose in the world as greatly radiant, highly renowned, dashing and saintly kings, and shone in every quarter of the world...

verses.sanskrit: यौ तावर्जुनवृक्षौ तु व्रजे सत्योपयाचनौ। पुत्रस्योपरि तावेतौ पतितौ ते महीरुहौ॥२२॥
verses.english: In all the time cycles these forty-nine sages - सप्त-सप्तकाः ऋशयः - will be there for the wellbeing and for the protection of the world, of course, with a little difference in their nomenclature, according as in earlier era - प्राक् दिश - पूर्व कल्प प्रकारः... vividly - finishing off their duty in this world, a batch of four sages in each manvantaram, 4 x 7 = 28, will ascend to heaven, where their merit will be metered up or down according to their deeds, and then they will ascend to the abode of brahma, which is याम शून्य, निरामय - a diseaseless, a perishless abode, owing to the merit accumulated both in this and in the other world. Then after the end of one time cycle, other vAyu devA-s, aeronomic gods, will be ascending to those positions according to the power of their ascesis...

verses.sanskrit: दृढेन दाम्ना तत्रैव बद्धो वत्स इवोदरे। जहास वृक्षयोर्मध्ये तव पुत्रः स बालकः॥२३॥
verses.english: Thus, oh bharata, I have said about seven time cycles that have elapsed, including the one which is running now, and now you know about the six time cycles that are going to come...

verses.sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठ गच्छ दुर्मेधे मूढे पण्डितमानिनि। पुत्रमानय जीवन्तं मुक्तं मृत्युमुखादिव॥२४॥
verses.english: सावर्णि-मनु-s are five, oh king janamejaya, and the earliest and important one out of those five is the son of sun, the son of vivasvat, of whom I have already told you. The other four are the sons of परमेष्ठि-prajApati, and the grandsons of daksha prajApati, because lady प्रिय, the daughter of daksha, begot them all... these four highly vigorous personalities have undertaken a rigorous ascesis on Mt. Meru, and obtained a perfect likeness in the loftiness of Mt. meru... hence they are called मेरु-सावर्णि-s...

verses.sanskrit: सा भीता सहसोत्थाय हाहाकारं प्रकुर्वती। तं देशमगमद्यत्र पातितौ तावुभौ द्रुमौ॥२५॥
verses.english: ८। रौच्य / भौत्य मन्वन्तम्: One who is the son of रुचि प्रजापति is there, called रौच्य, or भौत्य... because he is begotten by lady भूति through ruchi prajApati... thus this रौच्य is also called as भौत्य maternally, hence the eighth time cycle is named after him as भौत्य मन्वन्तम्...

verses.sanskrit: सा ददर्श तयोर्मध्ये द्रुमयोरात्मजं शिशुम्। दाम्ना निबद्धमुदरे कर्षमाणमुलूखलम्॥२६॥
सा गोपी गोपवृद्धश्च समुवाच व्रजस्तदा। पर्यागच्छन्त ते द्रष्टुं गोपेषु महदद्भुतम्॥२७॥
verses.english: It is said that are these highly blessed great sages are the coequals of brahma in receiving reverence, and hence these highminded sages are made as seven-sages...

verses.sanskrit: जजल्पुस्ते यथाकामं गोपा वनविचारिणः। केनेमौ पातितौ वृक्षौ घोषस्यायतनोपमौ॥२८॥
verses.english: These blemishless sages are stationed in brahma's abode and they are reverential by the way of their birth, ascesis, education and heuristic methods - मन्त्रम् व्याकरण...

verses.sanskrit: विना वातं विना वर्षं विद्युत्प्रपतनं विना। विना हस्तिकृतं दोषं केनेमौ पातितौ द्रुमौ॥२९॥
verses.english: They act collectively with their knowledge about the triad of times, and by the virtue of their ascesis...

verses.sanskrit: अहो बत न शोभेतां विमूलावर्जुनाविभौ। भूमौ निपतितौ वृक्षौ वितोयौ जलदाविव। यदीमौ घोषरचितौ घोषकल्याणकारिणौ॥३०॥
verses.english: And those belonging to brAhmaNA class have to take recourse to these seven sages for their education in Veda-s, and for their excellence, because the brahmaNA-s have to follow rigorous daily chores of their practices - निष्ठ, remember the genealogy of sages, गोत्र-प्रवर नामानि etc...

verses.sanskrit: नन्दगोप प्रसन्नौ ते द्रुमावेवं गतावपि। यच्च ते दारको मुक्तो विपुलाभ्यामपि क्षितौ॥३१॥
verses.english: These seven are reckoned as seven-sages by virtue of their basic traits, say शम, दम आदि गुणा-s, and these are long-lived, hymnologists, foresighted, and self-sovereign...

verses.sanskrit: औत्पातिकमिदं घोषे तृतीयं वर्तते त्विह। पूतनाया विनाशश्च द्रुमयोः शकटस्य च॥३२॥
verses.english: Hence, we need not think about the age, time and stature of these sages, because we have no yardsticks to measure them up, because they seek boons from others, for the sake of others, but not for themselves... thus I have narrated about the seven sages, in general...

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन्स्थाने च वासोऽयं घोषस्यास्य न युज्यते। उत्पाता ह्यत्र दृश्यन्ते कथयन्तो न शोभनम्॥३३॥
verses.english: When dharma deteriorates, then the offspring of these save-sages who are well versed in scriptures will emerge from time to time, only to resurrect that dharma...

verses.sanskrit: नन्दगोपस्तु सहसा मुक्त्वा कृष्णमुलूखलात्। निवेश्य चाङ्के सुचिरं मृतं पुनरिवागतम्॥३४॥
verses.english: Hence, we need not think about the age, time and stature of these sages, because we have no yardsticks to measure them up, because they seek boons from others, for the sake of others, but not for themselves... thus I have narrated about the seven sages, in general...

verses.sanskrit: नातृप्यत्प्रेक्षमाणो वै कृष्णं कमललोचनम्। ततो यशोदां गर्हन्वै नन्दगोपो विवेश ह। स च गोपजनः सर्वो व्रजमेव जगाम ह॥३५॥
verses.english: And the gods in this cycle are called as भूत-रजस, who are also called as अ-भूत-रजस; and पारिव्रज, पारि-प्लव...

verses.sanskrit: स च तेनैव नाम्ना तु कृष्णो वै दामबन्धनात्। गोष्ठे दामोदर इति गोपीभिः परिगीयते॥३६॥
verses.english: ९। मेरु सावर्णि / रोहित सावर्णि मन्वन्तम्: Now I will tell about the sages of first sAvarNi manu, i.e., ninth manu, who is also called as रोहित सावर्णि, or मेरु सावर्णि। Those sages are: मेधातिथि from पौलस्त्य gotra, lineage... वसु from काश्यप lineage, ज्योतिष्मान् from भृगु lineage... द्युतिमान् from अन्गीरस lineage... सावन from the lineage of वशिष्ठ... and हव्यवाहन from the lineage of sage अत्रि...

verses.sanskrit: एतदाश्चर्यभूतं हि बालस्यासीद्विचेष्टितम्। कृष्णस्य भरतश्रेष्ठ घोषे निवसतस्तदा॥३७॥
verses.english: And oh, king janamejaya, there will be only three groups of devatA-s in the reign of sAvarNi...
